text: Oh I'm in such a state, sorry. I've got my grandson tonight, he's 4. One of his eyes has gone pink and it's all sticky and crusty in the corner, I've been wiping it with cotton wool. I took his temperature and it's 37.7. He's got a few insect bites on his legs from the park as well and he won't stop scratching them. His mum's away and I don't want to get it wrong, I didn't know whether to call or wait till morning.
